learning_outcomes.text: Know Turkish culture and Turkish civilization.
Analyze the first ethnographic sources about Turks.
Explain the elements forming Turkish states in history; state, administrative, military, and social structure in Turks.
Analyze popular beliefs and mythologies among Turks.
Be able to create projects and ideas related to the transmission of natural and cultural heritage to future generations.

syllabus_topics: State, administrative, military and social structure in Turks
Popular beliefs and mythology in Turks
Human and space relationship in Turks
Oral, written and material culture in Turks
Demographic and cultural consequences of migrations in Turkish history
Spread areas of Turkish culture and its influence on neighboring geographies
Tangible and intangible cultural heritage of Turkey
Transmission of natural and cultural heritage to future generations
